text:
elaine_sales: Hey team :wave: — ACME Bank POC kickoff tomorrow. Need a quick preflight sprint to close out crypto/compliance items: key handoff playbook, pen-test window, and final pricing for customer-managed keys via HSM. Customer targets: p99 latency ~60ms, rotation cadence 3-5 days, FIPS 140-2 attestation required. Can we do a 30m sync at 09:30 PT?

matt_eng: 09:30 PT works for me. Quick Q: do they want CloudHSM or an on-prem HSM appliance? That affects network/firing rules and billing.

elaine_sales: They're open but leaning toward AWS CloudHSM in a dedicated VPC. They asked for an option with private key material never leaving their HSM.

julia_security: From security side — we need to answer the questionnaire items around key ceremony, split-knowledge, and key usage policies. Also need to confirm we can provide attestation docs for the HSM firmware and vendor. I'll pull the checklist.

sam_solutions: I'll prep an acceptance criteria doc and minimal test harness for them. Proposed tests: 1) throughput sanity (500 req/s sustained), 2) latency p99, 3) failover/backoff when HSM unavailable, 4) rotation dry-run. I'll link a quick example for the HSM handshake they can run in staging.

sam_solutions: ```
# sample HSM connection check (pseudo)
openssl s_client -connect hsm.example.internal:443 -servername hsm
# or simple KMS handshake
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <tok>' https://redwood.example/api/v1/keys/handshake
```

matt_eng: Network note — we'll need IP allowlist for their NAT/egress. Ops needs the exact CIDR list before we enable connectivity. Sample firewall entry: ```
allow from 52.23.45.0/24 to 10.10.32.0/24 tcp 443
```

julia_security: On the questionnaire, ask them to confirm: who holds the CMK policy, who can rotate keys, and do they require split custody for rotations? If they require multi-person key ceremony, we need to schedule SOW time.

elaine_sales: Good call. Also they asked about pricing delta between hosted KMS proxy vs Dedicated HSM-backed endpoints. Can someone give a ballpark we can quote in the meeting?

sam_solutions: Ballpark: Hosted KMS proxy (customer-managed keys) — smaller upcharge, metered per-request + storage. Dedicated HSM-backed endpoints — fixed monthly reservation + per-token egress. I'll draft numbers after we pick target qps for the test.

ops_bot: runbook-bot: Preflight runbook created: /runbooks/acme-preflight-2892507777. Includes checklist: network, handshake test, rotation dry-run, attestation artifacts. :white_check_mark:

matt_eng: For the rotation window — 3-5 days is broad. We should confirm whether they want automatic rotation (service-triggered) or manual with Ops approval. Automatic rotations with short windows can increase key churn and cache misses; impacts latency.

julia_security: Also need to confirm log scrubbing requirements and retention for key operations. Some customers mandate that raw key IDs are never logged; only key aliases.

elaine_sales: Ok — agenda for tomorrow: 1) finalize HSM hosting option, 2) agree on test QPS and latency SLOs, 3) pick rotation workflow (auto vs manual), 4) pricing roughs, 5) security docs/attestation timeline. I'll send the calendar invite. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
